payload.content: CRISIL's annexure row for ISIN INE001A07RW5 lists a 7.87% coupon, allotment on 18 July 2019, scheduled maturity on 18 July 2022, and an issue size of
Rs 5,000 crore. CRISIL assigned AAA/Stable on 31 July 2020; that is the strongest credit evidence in the record, but it is an opinion, not a
guarantee or a current rating. The FY20 MD&A reports standalone total income of Rs 58,763 crore, profit after tax of Rs 17,770 crore, and Rs 46,437
crore of secured redeemable NCDs raised at issuer level. The stated tenor is 1,096 days, about three years. Three scheduled annual coupons at 7.87%
would sum to 23.61% of principal; that is not a yield. The annexure calls the instrument a debenture, but the retained excerpt does not establish
series-level security. The record has no executable price, yield, or secondary-market liquidity, and it does not assert payment. This is a 31 July
2020 information set, not a current rating.
